tools.description: Swiss Army knife for CSV/TSV processing with 20+ subcommands
tools.usage:
csvtk stats data.csv # Show statistics
csvtk cut -f 1,3 data.csv # Select columns
csvtk filter -f 'age>30' data.csv # Filter rows
csvtk join -f id file1.csv file2.csv # Join files
csvtk plot hist -f age data.csv # Create histogram
